lines: All gone in body-stuff, sky-pervaded, deer-eyed:
envisioned then — of him contemplation steadies.
l4.sanskrit_cite: sarvaṃ dehagataṃ dravyaṃ viyadvyāptaṃ mṛgekṣaṇe | vibhāvayet tatas tasya bhāvanā sā sthirā bhavet
